Planetary Database
Sun
Star
  • Type: G-Type Main-Sequence Star Holding 99.86% Of All Solar System Mass.
  • Size: About 1.39 Million Km Wide; Surface Near 5,505°C, Core Near 15 Million °C.
  • Light Time: Sunlight Reaches Earth In About 8 Minutes 20 Seconds.
Mercury
Rocky Planet
  • Distance: 57.9 Million Km From The Sun; One Year Lasts Only 88 Earth Days.
  • Temperature: Swings From -180°C At Night To 430°C By Day.
  • Moons: None. Its Thin Exosphere Cannot Trap Heat.
Venus
Rocky Planet
  • Heat: Hottest Planet At 465°C From Runaway CO2 Greenhouse Effect.
  • Spin: Rotates Backward; One Day (243 Earth Days) Outlasts Its Year (225 Days).
  • Moons: None. Crushing Air Pressure, About 92 Times Earth.
Earth
Rocky Planet
  • Life: Only Known World With Life; Oceans Cover About 71% Of The Surface.
  • Year: 365.25 Days; 23.5° Axial Tilt Causes The Seasons.
  • Moons: One, The Moon, Which Stabilizes Our Axial Tilt.
Mars
Rocky Planet
  • Color: Red From Iron Oxide Dust; Thin CO2 Atmosphere.
  • Olympus Mons: Tallest Volcano In The Solar System At About 22 Km.
  • Moons: Two Small Moons, Phobos And Deimos; Day Lasts 24.6 Hours.
Jupiter
Gas Giant
  • Size: Largest Planet; Over 1,300 Earths Could Fit Inside.
  • Great Red Spot: A Storm Wider Than Earth Raging For Centuries.
  • Moons: 95 Known Moons; Ganymede Is The Largest Moon Of Any Planet.
Saturn
Gas Giant
  • Rings: Iconic Rings Made Of Ice And Rock, Yet Only About 10 Meters Thick.
  • Density: Least Dense Planet; It Would Float In Water.
  • Moons: 146 Confirmed Moons; Titan Has A Thick Nitrogen Atmosphere.
Uranus
Ice Giant
  • Tilt: Knocked On Its Side At 98°, So It Rolls Around The Sun.
  • Cold: Coldest Planetary Atmosphere At -224°C; Methane Gives Blue-Green Color.
  • Moons: 28 Known Moons And Faint Dark Rings.
Neptune
Ice Giant
  • Winds: Fastest Winds In The Solar System At About 2,100 Km Per Hour.
  • Discovery: Found By Mathematics In 1846 Before Any Telescope Saw It.
  • Moons: 16 Known Moons; Triton Orbits Backward Around The Planet.
